title: Prospective Multicenter Observational Study on the Dynamics of Clonal Hematopoiesis (CHIP) in Patients with Multiple Myeloma Following Cilta-cel CAR T-Cell Therapy
summary: This study investigates whether and how specific alterations in hematopoietic cells, known as clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP), change over time before and after CAR T-cell therapy. In addition, we aim to assess whether these alterations are associated with treatment-related adverse events or subsequent complications.

interventions.name: Adult patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma who are scheduled to receive CAR T-cell therapy with ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Age ≥ 18 years.
Diagnosis of relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.
Planned treatment with ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel) as part of routine clinical care.
Planned or clinically indicated bone marrow aspiration prior to CAR T-cell therapy, with willingness to allow the use of up to 10 mL of additional bone marrow aspirate for research purposes during this routine procedure.
Provision of written informed consent following appropriate medical explanation and counseling.
Exclusion criteria:
Missing or withdrawn informed consent.
Inability to provide informed consent without a legally authorized representative, unless representation is explicitly permitted by the approved ethics protocol and informed consent form (ICF) version.
Known overt myeloid neoplasm (e.g., myelodysplastic syndrome [MDS], acute myeloid leukemia [AML], or myeloproliferative neoplasm [MPN]) prior to CAR T-cell therapy. Such cases may be documented separately for descriptive purposes if clinically relevant but will not be included in the primary CHIP cohort.
Inability to obtain or use a routine clinical bone marrow sample.
